name: Asharq Al-Awsat
text: Hamas is waiting for a favorable reply from the Board of Peace in an effort to rescue the Gaza agreement.

name: Euronews
text: Russia reportedly used North Korean missiles in an attack on a key Ukrainian energy site, with Ukraine's foreign minister accusing Moscow of seeking to cut power, heat and water before winter.

name: Al Jazeera
text: Iraq's foreign minister said Baghdad is investigating attacks on Gulf states that were launched from Iraqi territory by outside parties.

name: Daily Sabah
text: Ukraine's president has expressed reservations about proposed U.S. plans for a new European security framework meant to end Russia's war against Ukraine.

name: The New Arab
text: Trump keeps saying US strikes destroyed Iran's nuclear programme, yet Washington is still seeking information about Iran's nuclear activities.

name: Ukrainska Pravda
text: Zelenskyy said Russia fired 36 ballistic missiles overnight at energy facilities, including North Korean KN-23s, and that four were intercepted.

name: Al Jazeera
text: Residents of Zaporizhzhia say Russian drone attacks have made a once-safer region increasingly dangerous, with 50 people killed in one attack.

name: Asharq Al-Awsat
text: A look at who holds the authority over Hezbollah's choice to enter a war, tracing the question from Tehran to Beirut.

name: AP
text: Missile strikes on Kyiv injured five people as Ukraine readies for talks involving Russia and the United States.

name: The Guardian
text: Russian strikes with drones and ballistic missiles hit power substations and a Dnipro bridge, leaving Kyiv facing blackouts and water shortages.

name: BBC News
text: Further Russian strikes have damaged Ukraine's power network, arriving just before delegations from both countries are set to meet in Abu Dhabi next week.

name: Kyiv Independent
text: Ukraine says it struck Russian Iskander-M missile launchers and air defence systems in Bryansk Oblast, as Moscow has fired over 500 ballistic missiles at Ukraine this year.

name: Al Jazeera
text: Hackers linked to Russia have leaked data belonging to Italy's foreign minister onto the dark web, and the prime minister has blamed them for the breach.

name: Al Jazeera
text: Oil traders are avoiding Russian diesel following a US-Russia arrangement, with no Russian diesel arriving in the US as tankers reroute and buyers worry about possible legal action.

name: AP
text: An airstrike near Yemen's capital has reportedly killed 22 people, according to a Houthi official.

name: Reuters
text: Italy's foreign minister says pro-Russian hackers have targeted him because of Rome's support for Ukraine.

name: Al Jazeera
text: Dozens have been killed as Yemen's humanitarian situation worsens, with government forces regaining ground in Taiz and Lahij but facing setbacks in some areas against Houthi resistance.

name: AP
text: Iran has announced it is lifting its self-imposed restriction on the range of its missiles, according to a report summarizing Middle East developments.

name: Euronews
text: The US military carried out fresh strikes on Iranian defence systems, which Trump calls minor, as diplomatic efforts with Tehran continue.

name: Fars
text: A Lebanese minister said more than 16,000 hectares of farmland and forest were burned during an Israeli offensive in southern Lebanon.

name: The National
text: Iran's foreign minister Araghchi has held discussions with twelve foreign ministers in an effort to ease regional tensions.
